extName.description: Name of the extension. Working name; the product will be renamed before release.

extDescription.message: Arc-style Spaces and a vertical sidebar for Chrome, synced through your Chrome bookmarks.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown on the extensions page and in the Chrome Web Store.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the extension's toolbar icon, which opens the sidebar in Chrome's side panel.

homeSpaceName.description: Name of the Space created when the user has none. It is written into the user's bookmarks as a folder title.

loading.description: Shown in the sidebar while it waits for the user's Spaces.

libraryError.message: Couldn't read your Spaces from bookmarks.
libraryError.description: Shown in the sidebar when the user's Spaces can't be read from Chrome bookmarks.

windowError.message: Couldn't tell which window the sidebar is in. Close the sidebar and open it again.
windowError.description: Shown in the sidebar when Chrome doesn't say which browser window the sidebar belongs to.

notSyncingTitle.description: Heading of the notice shown when the user's Spaces are stored in bookmarks that don't sync to their account.

notSyncingBody.message: Your Spaces are saved on this device only. Turn on bookmark sync in Chrome to keep them on all your devices.
notSyncingBody.description: Body of the notice shown when the user's Spaces are stored in bookmarks that don't sync to their account.

favoritesLabel.description: Accessible label of the row of Favorites, the saved entries shown in every Space.

pinnedTabsLabel.description: Accessible label of the list of the Space's Pinned tabs and Folders.

emptySpace.message: No Pinned tabs yet. Drag a tab here to pin it.
emptySpace.description: Shown in place of the list of Pinned tabs when the Space has none.

pinTab.description: Menu item on a Today tab in the sidebar. Keeps the tab's page in the Space as a Pinned tab.

unpinTab.description: Menu item on a Pinned tab in the sidebar. Removes it from the Space; its open tab stays open as a Today tab.

returnToPinnedUrl.description: Button on a Pinned tab whose tab has browsed to another page. Takes the tab back to the page that was pinned.

tabPickedUp.message: Picked up $NAME$. Drop it among the Pinned tabs to pin it.
tabPickedUp.description: Read out by screen readers when the user starts dragging a Today tab in the sidebar. $NAME$ is the tab's title.

tabPinnedAnnouncement.description: Read out by screen readers when the user drops a Today tab among the Pinned tabs. $NAME$ is the tab's title.

tabNotPinned.description: Read out by screen readers when the user drops a Today tab they were dragging outside the Pinned tabs. $NAME$ is the tab's title.

pinnedTabNotOpen.description: Read out by screen readers after a Pinned tab's name when it has no open tab in this window.

pinnedTabWandered.description: Read out after a Pinned tab's name, and shown on hover, when its tab has browsed away from the pinned page. $PAGE$ is the page the tab shows now.

todayTabsLabel.description: Accessible label of the list of the Space's open tabs that aren't Pinned tabs or Favorites. Clicking one switches to that tab.

spaceSwitcherLabel.description: Accessible label of the row of Space icons at the bottom of the sidebar.

toggleSidebarModeCommand.message: Switch the sidebar between Auto-hide and Docked
toggleSidebarModeCommand.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut, shown in Chrome's extension shortcut settings. Auto-hide: the sidebar slides over the page from the window's edge. Docked: the sidebar stays open in Chrome's side panel.

settingsLabel.description: Heading that opens the sidebar's settings.

autoHideLabel.description: Label of the switch that turns on Auto-hide, the sidebar mode where the sidebar stays hidden until the mouse reaches the window's edge.

autoHideHint.message: Hide the sidebar until the mouse reaches the edge of the window. Chrome asks for access to all websites, because the sidebar appears on top of them.
autoHideHint.description: Explains the Auto-hide switch and why turning it on asks for access to all websites.

autoHideDeclined.message: Auto-hide needs access to websites, so the sidebar stays Docked in Chrome's side panel.
autoHideDeclined.description: Shown after the user declines access to all websites when turning on Auto-hide. Docked: the sidebar stays open in Chrome's side panel.

autoHideFrameTitle.description: Accessible title of the frame that shows the sidebar over a web page in Auto-hide mode.

newSpace.description: Label of the button that starts creating a Space, and heading of the form that creates one.

editSpace.description: Label of the button that shows the form for changing the Space's name, icon and color.

spaceNameField.description: Label of the field for a Space's name.

spaceIconField.description: Label of the choice of emoji shown at the start of a Space's name.

noIcon.description: Option for a Space with no emoji at the start of its name.

otherEmojiField.description: Label of a small field where the user types or pastes any emoji as a Space's icon.

spaceColorField.description: Label of the choice of a Space's color, one of Chrome's tab group colors.

createSpace.description: Button that creates the Space described in the form.

cancel.description: Button that closes a form without saving it.

doneEditing.description: Button that closes the form for changing a Space. Changes are already saved.

spaceNameTaken.description: Shown when the user tries to give a Space a name that another Space already has. Space names must be unique.

spaceNameEmpty.description: Shown when the user tries to save a Space with an empty name.

spaceIconInvalid.message: Use a single emoji as the icon.
spaceIconInvalid.description: Shown when the user types something other than one emoji as a Space's icon.

spaceNotFound.message: This Space no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.
spaceNotFound.description: Shown when the user changes a Space that was deleted in the meantime.

pinnedTabNotFound.message: This Pinned tab no longer exists. It may have been removed on another device.
pinnedTabNotFound.description: Shown when the user opens or unpins a Pinned tab that was removed in the meantime.

commandFailed.message: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
commandFailed.description: Shown when a change to a Space or a Pinned tab fails unexpectedly.

colorGrey.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorBlue.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorRed.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorYellow.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorGreen.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorPink.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorPurple.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorCyan.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

colorOrange.description: Name of one of Chrome's nine tab group colors, offered as a Space's color. Use the same word Chrome uses for this tab group color.

moveSpaceHint.message: Drag to move this Space. With the keyboard, hold Alt and press the Left or Right arrow key.
moveSpaceHint.description: Read by screen readers for each Space's icon at the bottom of the sidebar. Explains how to reorder Spaces.

spacePickedUp.description: Announced to screen readers when the user starts dragging a Space's icon.

spaceMovingOver.description: Announced to screen readers while the user drags a Space's icon over a new position among the Spaces.

spaceMoved.description: Announced to screen readers after the user moves a Space to a new position among the Spaces.

spaceMoveCancelled.description: Announced to screen readers when the user drops a Space's icon without moving it, or cancels the drag.
